observations: Front-loading washing machine visible, silver/grey cabinet.
LG logo clearly printed on upper left of control panel.
Model text on panel reads 'INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg'.
Sticker on door area reads 'LG Washer+Dryer 2 in 1'.
Control panel lights are illuminated (dial ring lit, digital display showing digits), suggesting the unit has power.
Door glass shows some laundry inside; drum area has grime and water staining at base.
No visible damage, dents, or missing parts; machine looks largely intact, not stripped as 'scrap' usually implies.

read_from: photo 0 control panel and door sticker

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows 'LG' logo and 'LG DirectDrive' branding on the control panel, not Samsung.
No power-on test, spin cycle, or error-code video shown; control panel lights appear lit in the photo, which is inconsistent with a fully dead unit but does not prove full function.
Physical condition in photo looks largely intact, not visibly cannibalized; scrap status cannot be confirmed from a single still photo.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch between seller's text and photo could indicate a copy-pasted or mismatched listing.
risks.proof: A new photo showing the rating plate/serial sticker (usually inside door frame or rear panel) confirming brand and model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/unverified identity, treated cautiously as possible listing error or scam risk

risks.risk: Actual functional state unknown (motor, drum bearing, control board, heating element could all be faulty).
risks.proof: Video of unit being powered on and attempting a wash cycle, or at least spinning drum manually.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working, parts/repair value only

risks.risk: Hidden water damage or rust inside drum/tub not visible from front photo.
risks.proof: Photo of drum interior with door open and tub removed if possible, plus rear panel photo.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible internal corrosion, lower end of scrap value

risks.risk: Missing accessories (hoses, power cable, drawer) that affect resale/repair cost.
risks.proof: Photo of back of unit showing hoses and power cord, and detergent drawer.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating/serial plate (inside door rim or rear panel) to confirm true brand and model.
Video of the machine being plugged in and powered on, showing display and any attempt to start a cycle.
Photo of the rear of the machine showing hoses, power cable, and overall condition.
Photo with drum/door open showing interior condition (rust, damage, foreign objects).
response.reason: The seller's text claims the brand is Samsung while the photographed unit is clearly branded LG (logo and model markings visible), a direct contradiction that raises concern about a mismatched or copy-pasted listing rather than a simple typo.
